positive_cases.name: domain_group_removal_by_admin
positive_cases.scenario: Administrator removes a member from a privileged domain group.
positive_cases.rationale: Removal and privileged group selections match, and the filter does not apply.

positive_cases.name: local_group_removal_by_admin
positive_cases.scenario: Administrator removes a member from the local administrators group.
positive_cases.rationale: Removal and privileged group selections match, and the filter does not apply.

negative_cases.name: governance_service_removal
negative_cases.scenario: Governance automation expires a time-bound grant.
negative_cases.rationale: Selections match but the governance service filter removes the event.

negative_cases.name: application_group_removal
negative_cases.scenario: Member removed from an application access group.
negative_cases.rationale: The privileged group selection does not match.

negative_cases.name: privileged_group_addition
negative_cases.scenario: Member added to a privileged group.
negative_cases.rationale: The event identifier selection covers removals only.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
